definition: one of two equal parts of something
description: In a bright kitchen a young chef in a blue apron runs a long knife through a white onion on a wooden board, leaving a heap of onion rings. Cut to a garden table where an older man in a grey polo presses a knife down through a whole watermelon until the green rind splits in two. Then a bearded man in a checked shirt swings an axe into a big log on a woodpile and it splits open. Finally a woman standing in a huge orange pumpkin in a field raises a long blade over her head and brings it down, and the pumpkin lies open in two seedy halves on the grass.

en.question: What is the woman in jeans doing?

de.answer: Sie schneidet einen großen Kürbis in zwei Hälften.
de.question: Was macht die Frau in Jeans?

es.answer: Está cortando una calabaza grande por la mitad.
es.question: ¿Qué está haciendo la mujer de vaqueros?

fr.answer: Elle coupe une grosse citrouille en deux.
fr.question: Que fait la femme en jean ?
